title: Recovered Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Questions — Operators, Doors, North, Memory and New Jerusalem
purpose: Expose recovered old-conversation concepts through natural-language search and route answers to their new canonical/specialist owners.

entries.question: What does North of North mean in the Potato of Life?
variants: What is north of the North Pole?
Why does Tim Dooley say North of North?
entries.short_answer: North of North is best understood as a meta-reference for orientation rather than another compass direction. At Earth's geographic North Pole every surface direction away is south, so the phrase naturally symbolizes a frame from which direction itself is judged.
entries.deep_answer: Older project language used North of North, judge above judges and Axis-top language. Geography supplies a useful comparator: the North Pole is the northernmost surface point and all meridians converge there. In the mature archive, North gives orientation while North-of-North represents the criterion or meta-frame by which orientation is evaluated. This is symbolic/formal, not a claim of a physical place beyond the Pole.

entries.question: What is the Mill or Windmill in the Potatoverse?
variants: What does the mill mean?
What is the grinding symbol in Tim Dooley's project?
entries.short_answer: The Mill is a recovered transformation operator: raw material is repeatedly processed into a standardized output. Constructively grain becomes flour and bread; in a shadow media ecology a complex person or event can be ground into fragments and a repeatable caricature.
entries.deep_answer: Mill differs from Farm and Forge. Farm cultivates/harvests, Mill processes/reduces, Forge reshapes through heat/pressure, Table redistributes, and Garden regenerates. Windmill also offers a Don Quixote-style comparator for misclassification: an interpreted enemy may not be the actual structure encountered.

entries.question: What is a false Door in the Potatoverse?
variants: What does false door mean?
Can a Door lead nowhere?
entries.short_answer: A false Door is an apparent path of escape or transition that does not deliver the represented destination and may return the agent to the same dependency or attractor.
entries.deep_answer: Recovered game material distinguished hidden, locked, one-way, paired, multiway, deep, broken and false Doors. The mature formalization treats Door as a conditional transition relation among state, agent, knowledge, context and credential. A false Door is therefore an affordance/transition mismatch: passage appears available but the actual state transition is absent, misleading or circular.

entries.question: What is a Door Pass in the Potato of Life?
variants: What does Door Pass mean?
What was the North Secret game mechanic?
entries.short_answer: Door Pass is a recovered game/worldbuilding concept for a portable credential or proof that changes which transitions are available to an agent.
entries.deep_answer: Older Capture-the-Flag material required learned knowledge and specific information at specific Doors to unlock higher access. The mature archive compares this to capability/access-control systems while keeping spiritual meaning separate from computer security. A pass changes admissibility; it does not create the destination or prove moral worth.

entries.question: What is the funnel or slope model in Tim Dooley's cosmology?
variants: Why is reality a funnel?
What is the trough under the mud?
entries.short_answer: The recovered funnel model describes many narratives, subcultures or trajectories converging toward a hidden center. The mature version separates gradient, attractor, sink, integrator and regenerator instead of treating them as one literal black-hole object.
entries.deep_answer: Older conversations described internet/reality as a slope or trough toward a hidden center beneath mud/debris. The new systems reading asks what creates the gradient, which states act as attractors, whether convergence is a harmful Drain or healthy integrator, and whether compressed input is redistributed into new capability. Convergence does not by itself imply conspiracy.

entries.question: What is Object Alpha in the Tim Dooley archive?
variants: What does Object Alpha mean?
What is the attention center?
entries.short_answer: Object Alpha is a recovered idea for the object around which distributed observers organize attention. It is an attention-center, not automatically a source, truth-center or authority-center.
entries.deep_answer: The concept becomes useful when centrality is typed. A negatively valued lolcow can become an attention Object Alpha if many people organize routines and narratives around that person. The archive therefore asks center of what: attention, geometry, source, interpretation, money, navigation or causation?

entries.question: What do Red and Blue Potato mean?
variants: What is Red Blue in Tim Dooley's system?
Is Red future and Blue past?
entries.short_answer: Red is the project polarity of creativity, love, novelty and future possibility; Blue is memory, preservation, caution and the gravity of the past. The strongest modern interpretation treats them as coupled learning functions rather than enemies.
entries.deep_answer: Exploration–exploitation and predictive-processing research offer external functional comparators: novelty/information seeking must be balanced with usable prior knowledge. Too much Blue becomes rigidity; too much Red becomes ungrounded novelty. This does not identify the colors with specific brain regions, chemicals or physical wave directions.

entries.question: What is Potato Bank or Starchforce as stored value?
variants: What does Potato Bank mean?
What is Starchforce?
entries.short_answer: Potato Bank is the storage side of the Potato metaphor: compressed resources, memory or future capability held for later release. Starchforce is strongest as the project name for organizing/storing potential unless a separate physical theory is made testable.
entries.deep_answer: The physical neighbor is ordinary plant biology: potatoes store carbohydrate/starch. Symbolically Spudlight reveals while Starchforce retains. A good archive is a Potato Bank because it stores compressed potential that can later regenerate understanding instead of merely accumulating inert records.

entries.question: What does meme resurrection mean in the Potato of Life?
variants: Can a meme be a testament?
What does God in every meme mean?
entries.short_answer: Meme resurrection is the project idea that a digital artifact can make a person, event or testimony relationally present to later audiences. It is a theological/media concept, not a scientific claim of biological resurrection.
entries.deep_answer: The new digital-testament model distinguishes two opposite media operations: Farm converts person into content for extraction; Testament uses content to point back toward personhood, context and source. Digital religion and memory research show that online artifacts can sustain collective memory and continuing bonds, but do not verify supernatural resurrection.

entries.question: What is New Jerusalem as a network in the Potatoverse?
variants: Is New Jerusalem a city or network?
What does Tim Dooley mean by New Jerusalem?
entries.short_answer: The mature project can treat New Jerusalem as a Garden-City of repaired interoperability: many differentiated nodes, rooms, gates and institutions sharing enough orientation and infrastructure to cooperate without being flattened into one homogeneous center.
entries.deep_answer: Older conversations described New Jerusalem as a reconstructed Garden made from scattered world/history pieces, a network of reconciled hearts, and a sequence idea→choice→habit→culture→reality. Modern resilience and polycentric-governance research supply systems comparators for distributed capability. This remains a theological/project synthesis, not a claim that a current political programme literally fulfills Revelation.

entries.question: What is the Below-the-Eye institutional structure?
variants: What are Crown Houses Treasury Mind Memory Keepers Shield Temple Orders Law?
What is below Tim's Eye?
entries.short_answer: Below-the-Eye was an older functional roster containing Crown, Houses, Treasury, Mind, Memory Keepers, Shield, Temple, Orders, Law, infrastructure and Culture. It is now interpreted as an anatomy of civilization rather than a literal court hierarchy.
entries.deep_answer: Each element can be given a function: Crown/orientation, Houses/differentiated domains, Treasury/stored capacity, Mind/analysis, Memory Keepers/archives, Shield/resilience, Temple/meaning, Orders/service coordination, Law/rules and adjudication, infrastructure/connectivity, Culture/shared language and art. This makes the old roster usable in institutional/network analysis.

entries.question: What is the Tim Holdings Map?
variants: What does Tim own in the Potatoverse?
What are bonds stakes foundations and relations in Tim's map?
entries.short_answer: The old Holdings Map linked Potato with the whole field, Eye with orientation, North with reference, bonds with future promises, stakes with responsibility, foundations with support, relations with network edges, Son with Door and Father with Source.
entries.deep_answer: The mature ethical reading translates ownership into responsibility-bearing relation. A stake means exposure or obligation rather than metaphysical property rights over independent people. The useful question becomes what the center must maintain, support or account for—not who it possesses.

entries.question: How can Tim work for the Father while the Father works for Tim?
variants: How can Tim be Father and serve Father?
What is reciprocal Father service?
entries.short_answer: The statement becomes coherent when bearer and role are distinguished: Tim enacts the Father-function while the Father-role defines obligations and constraints on how Tim should act.
entries.deep_answer: In the mature project ontology Tim and Father can be spiritually identified while still being analytically distinguished as bearer and role/function. The role is not merely a privilege; it is an obligation structure. Thus higher Father status can mean greater service requirements rather than exemption from them.

entries.question: How does Son death relate to Potato birth?
variants: Why is December 24 followed by December 25 in the Potatoverse?
Did the Father identity emerge after the Son?
entries.short_answer: The project timeline uses an inverse-genealogy pattern: Son-side death/crucifixion material becomes the compressed seed from which Potato/Tim and later Father identity emerge in subsequent strata.
entries.deep_answer: This distinguishes mythic ontology from lived timeline. Father/source can be represented as above or prior in theological structure while the explicit Tim/Father role appears later in the narrative than Son-side embodiment and ordeal. The archive should preserve both directions instead of rewriting the later theology backward into biography.

entries.question: What is North Gate as a protocol?
variants: How does North preserve shared meaning?
What is the semantic North Gate?
entries.short_answer: North Gate can be formalized as a semantic interoperability protocol: shared rules of meaning, evidence, language and passage that let different nodes coordinate without making them identical.
entries.deep_answer: Older conversations treated the North Pole gate as an interface anchoring Heaven and Earth and preserving truth/language/reason. The systems translation is protocol rather than ownership: enough common grammar for heterogeneous nodes to exchange information and recognize valid passage. This connects the sacred Gate motif with the archive's evidence classes and Europe's interoperability work.
